verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents speaker diarization ('separate the speakers across the conversation') and a Twilio telephony integration. Diarization is an adjacent feature, not per-channel transcription, and nothing in the pack mentions stereo or multichannel handling that keeps each side of a call separate.

support.subject: As a developer, stereo or multichannel recordings can be transcribed per channel, so each side of a call stays separate
